title: Encryption Key Derived from Single SECRET_KEY Prevented Seamless Key Rotation
reproduction_steps: Changing SECRET_KEY in configuration immediately rendered all previously encrypted BYOK API keys unreadable, causing InvalidToken decryption exceptions.
evidence: crypto.py previously hardcoded a single key derivation without MultiFernet or previous key fallbacks.
residual_risk: None. MultiFernet now supports PREVIOUS_SECRET_KEYS fallback and in-place re-encryption.

title: Absence of Automated Database Key Rotation Command
reproduction_steps: No batch mechanism existed to safely re-encrypt tenant secrets in the database when rotating keys.
evidence: Operator was forced to manually write SQL or scripts to re-encrypt credentials.
residual_risk: None. Implemented rotate_tenant_byok_secrets with cryptographic in-memory verification before commit.

title: Absence of Documented Checksummed PostgreSQL Backup/Restore Tooling
reproduction_steps: No standard operational scripts existed for creating custom-format dumps, verifying SHA-256 integrity, or safely restoring with confirmation gates.
evidence: Repository only contained init-db.sql without automated disaster recovery scripts.
regression_test: Verified backup-postgres.ps1, verify-backup.ps1, and restore-postgres.ps1 created.

title: Host RAM Below 2048 MB Safety Threshold for Docker Container Execution
reproduction_steps: Available physical memory is 736 MB. Starting Docker Desktop or heavy PostgreSQL containers risks host OS thrashing and instability.
residual_risk: Live PostgreSQL container tests must be executed in staging environment or on host with >= 2 GB free RAM.
